api/src/worker/__init__.py.name: Worker package
api/src/worker/__init__.py.description: Marks the part of the platform that runs queued work away from the main server.

api/src/worker/admission.py.name: Memory admission
api/src/worker/admission.py.description: Decides whether a worker has enough free memory to take on another piece of work.

api/src/worker/api_agent.py.name: In-server summary runner
api/src/worker/api_agent.py.description: Runs run summaries inside the main server process whenever there is spare memory for it.

api/src/worker/health.py.name: Worker readiness
api/src/worker/health.py.description: Tells the platform when a worker has finished starting and is ready to take work.

api/src/worker/main.py.name: Worker entry point
api/src/worker/main.py.description: Starts the worker that picks up queued work on a machine of its own.

api/src/worker/pool_main.py.name: Work-claiming executor
api/src/worker/pool_main.py.description: Claims waiting runs from the shared job list and runs each one in a fresh process.

api/src/worker/remote/__init__.py.name: Remote workers package
api/src/worker/remote/__init__.py.description: Groups the pieces that let machines outside the main server run work for the platform.

api/src/worker/remote/agent_route.py.name: Remote agent runs
api/src/worker/remote/agent_route.py.description: Connects agent runs claimed by a remote machine back to the platform, with the right time limit applied.

api/src/worker/remote/fencing.py.name: Single owner guard
api/src/worker/remote/fencing.py.description: Makes sure only the current connection may act for a remote worker, so a replaced one cannot interfere.

api/src/worker/remote/host.py.name: Remote worker control
api/src/worker/remote/host.py.description: Keeps the connection to each remote worker, sends it work and takes back the results.

api/src/worker/remote/identity.py.name: Worker identity
api/src/worker/remote/identity.py.description: Loads a remote worker's fixed identity once, so reconnecting cannot turn it into a different machine.

api/src/worker/remote/launcher.py.name: Remote runner
api/src/worker/remote/launcher.py.description: Supervises the processes on a remote machine and reconnects without killing work already running.

api/src/worker/remote/ownership.py.name: Connection ownership
api/src/worker/remote/ownership.py.description: Gives one live connection the right to act for a remote worker, and lets it renew or hand over cleanly.

api/src/worker/remote/package_helper.py.name: Remote package installs
api/src/worker/remote/package_helper.py.description: Runs a single package installation command for a remote worker when the platform asks.

api/src/worker/remote/protocol.py.name: Secure worker messages
api/src/worker/remote/protocol.py.description: Defines the signed, size-limited messages the platform and remote workers exchange.

api/src/worker/remote/remote_pool.py.name: Remote process pool
api/src/worker/remote/remote_pool.py.description: Runs isolated work on remote machines while keeping the same bookkeeping as local workers.

WEBSOCKET /api/worker-control.name: Remote worker connection
WEBSOCKET /api/worker-control.description: Keeps a live link to each remote worker so the platform can send it work and hear back what happened.
